# Third-party source policy

`UniLION` is tracked as a Git submodule at the exact upstream commit recorded by this repository.

- Upstream: `https://github.com/happinesslz/UniLION`
- The upstream repository did not contain a `LICENSE` file when integrated.
- Do not copy, modify, redistribute, or commercially deploy the upstream code or weights until the authors clarify licensing.
- Checkpoints are stored outside Git and referenced by URL and SHA-256 only.
